meta.name: understand-chat
meta.description: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用知识图谱问答代码库，快速理解代码结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解陌生代码库的结构和逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Query codebase with knowledge graph to understand code quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand the structure and logic of an unfamiliar codebase

howto.what: 装上后，当你在项目中提问时，Claude 会先检查知识图谱文件是否存在，然后用搜索读取相关节点和连接，基于这些信息回答关于代码库的问题，并指出具体文件或函数的位置与关系。
howto.when: 当你想了解当前代码库的结构、询问某个模块或函数的用途与调用关系时触发。

say.text: 这个项目里 user 模块是做什么的？
say.note: 会检索知识图谱中的对应节点并回答。

say.text: 函数 getUser 被哪些地方调用了？
say.note: 会找出相关的调用边并说明调用链。

say.text: 这个代码库的分层结构是怎样的？
say.note: 会读取 layers 信息并解释架构分层。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude checks for the knowledge graph file, then greps for relevant nodes and edges to answer questions about the codebase, referencing specific files, functions and their relationships.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions about the current codebase or want to understand code using the knowledge graph.

say_en.text: What does the user module do in this project?
say_en.note: Looks up matching nodes in the graph.

say_en.text: Where is the function getUser called from?
say_en.note: Finds edges to trace the call chain.

say_en.text: What is the layered structure of this codebase?
say_en.note: Reads layer info and explains architecture.
